author: Codex (AI)
selection_rule: For each fixed calendar slot, port and sensor choose earliest catalogue acquisition, tie-break acquisition_key; retain chronologically ordered reserves. No prediction, score, cloud percentage or positive-count ranking. Test objects/results were not inspected. Radar targets without a compatible 30–90day context are ineligible.
radar_context_rule: Same relative orbit and direction; compatible ports and overlapping footprints; closest to 60 days, then largest overlap, then acquisition_key (history.choose_context).

test.first_slot_day_rule: April 2026 begins on day 2; later test months begin on day 1; subsequent anchors are day 12 and day 22.

activation_rule: Materialize/review selected dates first. Activate chronological reserves only for recorded access, missing compatible bands/context, missing observable mask, or zero reviewable marine area. No replacement for absence of ships or model performance. Review and freeze labels plus calibration protocol before training/evaluation.
selection_status: Primary dates fixed from metadata; labels, calibration policy and model outputs are not frozen or validated.
operational_order: Round 1 train, calibration, test; then repeat balanced two-primary-acquisition blocks per port/sensor. Observable quotas and support are audited separately; cloud failures remain in the sampling frame.

activated_reserves.reason: All eight published zone observations have no observable area under the quality mask; primary retained in coverage audit.
activated_reserves.evidence: reports/history/processing-plan.md; coordinator confirmed unusable acquisition before this activation.
